# edstem-cli 0.7.2

`--max` works again. 0.7.1 renamed it to `--limit` in a patch release, so scripts that passed `--max` stopped running. This release puts the old spelling back.

## Highlights

- **`--max` is a hidden alias for `--limit`** on `edstem threads` and `edstem activity`.

## Fixes

- 0.7.1 renamed `--max` to `--limit` to match the MCP input name and the sibling CLIs, and listed it as a compatibility note. A breaking rename does not belong in a patch release. `--max` is accepted again with the same validation, and it is left out of help so new scripts pick up `--limit`. `-n` is unchanged.

Everything else from 0.7.1 is unchanged, including the experimental interactive MCP views. See the [0.7.1 notes](https://github.com/bunizao/edstem-cli/releases/tag/v0.7.1).

## Upgrade

```bash
npm install -g edstem-cli@0.7.2
```

Or, from an earlier release:

```bash
edstem update
```

No configuration or token format changes.
